judgment.notes: All routine analytic applications have their required domains: normalized-measure L2 inputs for product coefficients, square-summable Fourier weights for embedding and continuity, complete Sobolev targets for extension, and continuous piecewise smooth paths for differentiation and integration. The series for B converges because 2-2pstar=-9/7<-1. No E/M application occurs.

S001 proves inverse-derivative smoothing, the H1 algebra bound and the J bound, with S_t inverse S_(-t) supplying unitarity. S002 proves B and inverse-derivative product estimates and both asymmetric bounds; the comparison uses pstar>1 and nonzero integer frequencies. In S003, k=r+s gives r^3+s^3-k^3=-3krs, and differentiating the phase divided by (ir)(is) gives 3ik, exactly 3B. Piecewise integration cancels internal endpoints. Dinv partial_x=P gives the stated C_I integrand, and the factor 1/2 in Stage gives 1/6. Symmetry and all bounded extensions follow as stated.
